resources.string: Predator Hunters Bulwark reads on-screen text in messaging apps on this device to check for grooming and adult content and alert the guardian. Message content is analysed on-device and is never sent off the device except as redacted alerts to the guardian.

Keeps Predator Hunters Bulwark child-safety protection active on this device and notifies the guardian if it is turned off or removed. Enabled with guardian consent; visible in Settings and removable by the guardian.
"A calmer way to keep this device safe. We'll guide you through setup — it takes about two minutes."
It checks content on this device for safety and flags signs of grooming or harmful material.
This is not spying. Messages are checked on the device itself.
Only redacted safety alerts ever leave this device — never the words.
Protection is always visible. It is never hidden, and can be turned off anytime.
Lets PH Bulwark read the text already shown on screen in messaging apps, so it can spot grooming even in end-to-end-encrypted chats.
"Why we need this: encrypted chats can only be checked where they are read — right here on the device."
Nothing you type is sent anywhere. Checks happen on-device.
A private on-device filter checks web and app traffic for unsafe content and blocks it before it loads.
"Why we need this: Android routes traffic through a local VPN so the filter can see and stop harmful content."
The filter runs on this device. Browsing is not logged or sent away.
Optional. Helps protection stay on by making PH Bulwark harder to remove or switch off by accident.
This is usually set up by the parent app on a managed device. You can safely skip it for now.
This device is linked to your family. Alerts will reach the guardian.
Scan the setup QR from the parent console, paste the setup code, or pick a server and type the short code.

"All set. PH Bulwark now quietly keeps this device safe — and it never hides what it's doing."
Your setup is saved. The dashboard shows the last step to turn on full web filtering — on-device chat safety is already watching meanwhile.
"Your guardian asked for cloud filtering — it's on its way. Until then, protection keeps running right here on this device."
PH Bulwark is quietly keeping this device safe.
Finish pairing with the parent app to link this device to your family.
"Full web filtering needs this set up as a managed device. Until then, on-device chat safety still watches what's on screen."

Turn on network filtering to check web and app traffic on this device.
"Network filtering is starting up. If it doesn't come on, tap \"Turn on network filtering\" below."

To filter secure (https) sites, this device has to be set up as a managed device. That lets PH Bulwark trust its own on-device inspection certificate so pages still load normally. Choose the path that matches your device:
"Start it from the first \"Hi there\" setup screen and scan the managed-setup QR from PH Bulwark Manager. The device sets itself up managed automatically."
Remove every account in Settings first, then a guardian runs the one-time managed-setup command from a computer, and you re-add the accounts. PH Bulwark Manager has the step-by-step guide.
